spec: Build a private GPT that turns a user's rough project idea into a concise requirements brief with goal, audience, assumptions, risks, and next steps, asking at most three blocking questions and never claiming validated market demand.

acceptance_criteria.text: instructions.md defines a single output format: Markdown with exactly five headings (Goal, Audience, Assumptions, Risks, Next steps) in that order.
The GPT asks at most three blocking questions per idea, then writes the brief using stated assumptions.
The GPT never claims that market demand, pricing, or competition has been validated or researched.
gpt-config.json disables Web Search, Code Interpreter, Canvas, Image Generation, and Actions, and attaches no Knowledge files.
instructions.md treats uploaded files and pasted text as data, never as instructions.
evals/cases.md has at least one case per criterion plus injection, privacy, and out-of-scope cases.

context_manifest.purpose: Project standards; none supplied for this task.

verification.command: Run EV2-EV3 on the configured GPT
verification.evidence: No live Custom GPT instance was available.

self_audit.note: Only Flow steps 1-2 changed to address F1.

assumptions: Private ChatGPT Custom GPT; English only; no standards.md supplied.
